verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets users describe problems in plain language (e.g. 'Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') to kick off intentions/tasks, and exposes an MCP endpoint so AI agents can interact with it, showing genuine natural-language-driven workflow entry points. However, actual execution still requires running a separate coding agent (Claude Code/Codex) and CLI commands rather than a built-in NL command interface for operating Foreloop itself.
